class.name: OcgSelect3dSensitiveset
class.brief_description: This class is base class for handling overlap detection of complex sensitive entities. It provides an interface for building BVH tree for some set of entities. Thereby, each iteration of overlap detection is a traverse of BVH tree in fact. To use speed-up hierarchical structure in a custom complex sensitive entity, it is necessary to make that custom entity a descendant of this class and organize sub-entities in some container which allows referencing to elements by index. Note that methods taking index as a parameter are used for BVH build and the range of given index is [0; Size() - 1]. For example of usage see Select3D_SensitiveTriangulation.

method.name: Select3D_SensitiveSet
method.description: Creates new empty sensitive set and its content

method.name: ToBuildBVH
method.description: Returns TRUE if BVH tree is in invalidated state

method.name: SetBuilder
method.description: Sets the method (builder) used to construct BVH.

method.name: MarkDirty
method.description: Marks BVH tree of the set as outdated. It will be rebuild at the next call of BVH()

method.name: CenterOfGeometry
method.description: Returns center of the whole set. This method should be redefined in Select3D_SensitiveSet descendants

method.name: Clear
method.description: Destroys cross-reference to avoid memory leak

method.name: GetLeafNodeSize
method.description: Returns a number of nodes in 1 BVH leaf

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: DefaultBVHBuilder
method.description: Return global instance to default BVH builder.

method.name: SetDefaultBVHBuilder
method.description: Assign new BVH builder to be used by default for new sensitive sets (assigning is NOT thread-safe!).
